stemEn: A newborn delivered with forceps is found to have an absent red reflex in the left eye. Which diagnosis best explains this finding?
explanationAr: غياب الـ red reflex عند الرضيع يستدعي تقييمًا عينيًا سريعًا. التجميع يذكر Congenital cataract كالإجابة المسترجعة لهذا السؤال.
reasoningEn: The source key identifies congenital cataract. Independent verification is still pending.
clinicalPearl: Any abnormal or absent red reflex in infancy requires urgent ophthalmic assessment.

stemEn: An infant has strabismus and an abnormal unilateral red reflex. Which of the recalled options was selected as the next step?
explanationAr: التجميع يذكر أن B قد تكون الإجابة المسترجعة، لكنه يوضح أن أفضل خطوة سريريًا هي urgent ophthalmology referral مع فحص شامل وقد يلزم examination under anesthesia. لأن هذا الخيار غير موجود أصلًا، يبقى السؤال متعارضًا ولا يصلح للنشر النهائي كما هو.
reasoningEn: The source itself states that the listed answer may not represent the best clinical next step and that urgent ophthalmology evaluation is preferable; CT is discouraged in possible RB1 disease.
incorrectOptionsAr: CT ليست الخيار المفضل كفحص أولي في leukocoria المشتبه بها حسب شرح المصدر، وTORCH قد يُطلب فقط حسب القصة والفحص وليس بدل التقييم العيني العاجل.
clinicalPearl: Leukocoria is an urgent ophthalmology referral finding.
diagnosticSteps: Consider ocular ultrasound and examination under anesthesia as directed by ophthalmology

stemEn: A 7-month-old boy presents with unilateral leukocoria. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: التجميع يختار Retinoblastoma في هذا السيناريو. Leukocoria في الرضع علامة عالية الأهمية وتحتاج تقييم عيون عاجل.
reasoningEn: The source key is retinoblastoma; independent confirmation is pending.
clinicalPearl: Retinoblastoma is a critical diagnosis to exclude in unilateral leukocoria.
diagnosticSteps: Further imaging/staging as directed by ophthalmology

stemEn: A child with an image suggestive of retinoblastoma is at increased risk of which additional malignancy?
explanationAr: التجميع يربط hereditary retinoblastoma / RB1 مع زيادة خطر الأورام الأولية اللاحقة، ويذكر Osteosarcoma كالإجابة المسترجعة.
reasoningEn: The source identifies osteosarcoma as the recalled associated subsequent malignancy.
clinicalPearl: Heritable RB1 disease carries a long-term risk of additional primary malignancies.

stemEn: A 2-year-old boy has strabismus on cover testing and a yellow-white pupillary reflex. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: وجود strabismus مع white/yellow pupillary reflex يوجّه بقوة في التجميع إلى Retinoblastoma. هذه علامة تستدعي تقييمًا عينيًا عاجلًا.
reasoningEn: The source key is retinoblastoma based on leukocoria plus strabismus.
clinicalPearl: Strabismus can be an initial presentation of retinoblastoma when accompanied by leukocoria.

stemEn: A 16-month-old girl appears cross-eyed, but the cover-uncover test shows no corrective movement and the corneal light reflex is centered in both eyes. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: المظهر الخارجي يوحي بالحول، لكن normal cover-uncover test وcorneal light reflex المركزي يدعمان Pseudostrabismus حسب التجميع.
reasoningEn: No refixation on cover testing with symmetric central corneal light reflex supports pseudostrabismus in the source.
clinicalPearl: Apparent crossing with normal alignment tests suggests pseudostrabismus.
managementSteps: Routine follow-up if examination is otherwise normal
Refer if true strabismus is suspected
